direct_qnn.exact_blocker: The physical SM8550 cannot keep the complete 37-context fused route resident. Larger fused contexts reach the backend residency/resource limit at ordinal 20, before setup completes or any graph executes.

memory.note: Android process RSS excludes DSP/backend allocations and cannot quantify total HTP residency

required_action: An all-loaded route now requires materially stronger within-context sharing or whole-route fusion that also passes host compilation and exact state/ordering validation. Layer/token context reload is not accepted as equivalent without a separate protocol decision.
claim_boundary: Physical direct-QNN deserialization evidence only. No graph/model/HTP execution, output, performance, campaign, or registry result exists.
